svg.title: Vade: an LLM inference engine and agent harness, written in Rust, built for the DGX Spark
svg.desc: VADE, drawn large in violet and blue monospace characters over a slow, sparse current of dots and dashes, as on vade.lol. An LLM inference engine and agent harness, written in Rust, built for the DGX Spark. Project sites: vade.lol and getvade.com.

g.text: An LLM inference engine and agent harness, written in Rust, built for the DGX Spark.
